claim: For operating income, Adobe topped $2.6 billion for the first time in the fiscal Q1 period of 2026.
summary: Cannot verify Adobe FY2026 Q1 operating income from knowledge available at 2026-01-04 cutoff; both the >$2.6B level and first-time status lack support.

sub_claims.text: Adobe's operating income in fiscal Q1 2026 was greater than $2.6 billion.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 predates Adobe FY2026 Q1 reporting expected March 2026; this quarterly value is not established by prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Fiscal Q1 2026 was the first time Adobe's operating income exceeded $2.6 billion.
sub_claims.stated_text: for the first time in the fiscal Q1 period of 2026
sub_claims.note: Cannot establish first-time status without the FY2026 Q1 result and complete prior history; beyond knowledge cutoff.
